standard.summary: 启用高级性能选项（TurboCore 优化器加速、Native 优化器等）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Enables the advanced performance options (TurboCore optimizer acceleration, the native optimizers and so on).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 启用高级性能选项（TurboCore 优化器加速、Native 优化器、窗口注意力等实验性功能）

advanced_en.principle: Enables advanced performance options (TurboCore optimizer acceleration, Native optimizer, window attention, and other experimental features).
